reviews.text: We could not be happier with the experience and result of working with Sunstone Pools. They did a fantastic job of turning our yard into what all of our friends and family call an oasis and a resort. Their team on contractors, communication, and result are all 5/5.We interviewed 5 pool. companies and we are so glad that we chose Sunstone. They excelled in their design process, and that was a great indication to us they they were the professionals that we had to hire. This pool was completed in may of 2024. I wanted to wait a year to write this review and am happy to report that we have has zero issues with our pool since it was completed.
reviews.author: Jeremy Bravo

reviews.text: Brad Cormac and his team did a complete renovation for our pool, decking, tile, etc and it is beautiful. We could not be more pleased. We highly recommend them. Timely, good follow through and skilled craftsman.
reviews.author: Karen Moratz

reviews.text: The team at Sunstone did an amazing job on our pool.  It started with the design, which was so far beyond anything we were envisioning.  When the pool was finished, it surpassed our expectations.  They transformed our yard into a resort.   No pool project goes off without a hitch, but Sunstone did a great job fixing issues that came up along the way.  We love our yard, and highly recommend Brad and his team!
reviews.author: daniel parry

reviews.text: Sunstone made our dreams come true!!! From the very first moment we walked in the door our experience has been top notch!   We can tell you without a doubt and wholeheartedly we recommend Sunstone Pools and Outdoor Living!! We met with Brad the owner and Jordan to discuss what we wanted.  Jordan designed our backyard keeping our vision in mind and he was on point!  Brad the owner was involved from the beginning to answer any questions and offer expert opinions.  Justin, the project manager was the greatest in keeping us updated on the schedule and what steps were next.  Anytime we had questions, Justin was right there getting the answers!!  The teams that worked the different projects were awesome!! They were very professional!
reviews.author: Michelle Murray

reviews.text: We have been very happy with our choice to use Sunstone. We purchased a lot to build a house and started with the pool. Tony was very helpful in helping us plan and implement the construction, Brad worked with us on the construction, and both Lynn and Brad have been instrumental in the finish out and the maintenance education, especially for pool newbies! We never felt like they were trying to sell us more than we wanted. Sunstone also coordinated the turf and stone placement of the yard and patio and they were attentive to making sure it was done correctly. The pool fits our empty nester lifestyle and is perfect for our lot. I know that if I have questions in the future, all I have to do is pick up the phone and call Lynn who is always available to answer my even small questions. You will be happy with the product and service of Sunstone Pools.
reviews.author: Susan Evans

reviews.text: Sunstone just finished putting in our new pool, and we are very happy. The owner, Brad Cormack, was great to work with and extremely knowledgeable. The company was very attentive to the little issues that always pop up on projects like this and were very quick to resolve. Jordan was very helpful through the design process and Alba did a great job of keeping us in the loop throughout the build. Would highly recommend Sunstone, we love our pool.
reviews.author: Mooch Jones

reviews.text: Sunstone did an amazing renovation on our pool! We bought a fixer upper that came with a swamp of a pool. It had been sitting for years not working and even had turtles in it. After meeting with over 10 pool companies, we went with Sunstone because of their professionalism and expertise.  Brad and Kevinn really took care of us. It was a complete renovation- new coping, tile, equipment and plaster. We couldn't be more happy with our beautiful new pool! Highly recommend. Thank you! Thank you! A+++
reviews.author: Lisa bailey

reviews.text: I have built several pools over the years and Sunstone is one of the worst companies to work with. No supervision on our project. The PM was fired the first week on our job. Takes several calls and follow-ups to get things done. The owner Brad was involved in our project which was very challenging and really didn't make things better.  Everything with this company was a challenge. I have had several people ask me who built my pool and there is no way I could recommend this company. They also don't honor their warranty. There's probably a good reason why they moved from Southlake to Colleyville. I rarely write Google reviews but feel obligated to let people know to avoid this company. Hire someone else!
reviews.author: Adam Bessette

reviews.text:
We started this process March 12th and it was completed before July 18th. We had 5 quotes. We did not plan on doing business with Sunstone. We expected them to be the most expensive. They were not the most expensive but the least. What sold us was the timeline and the promise that they had no supply issues as they were direct distributors. Some of the other companies admitted to supply issues and longer than usual construction times.

After we selected Sunstone we became very concerned. There was 0 communication from the office. With all he recent scams I became increasingly concerned about what was going to happen.

One day I received a call from Brandon introducing himself and saying they were ready to dig. That was may 18th from that point on I had absolutely 0 issues. Brandon was responsive and communicative. He works with integrity and honesty. He undercommitted and over delivered.

He took care of all the trades and made sure everything moved forward.

I also want to say all of the trades worked extremely hard to deliver a quality product. Every one of them from dig to plaster to pool school did a phenomenal job. Good work everyone and thank you.

My family loves the pool and it is amazing to step out and get in the spa or pool.

Thank you Brandon and all the trades thank you. Thank you Tony for the design and quick turnaround.

Only complaint is according to my contract I had to repair all damage to yard and drains except fence and sprinklers.
reviews.author: S B

reviews.text:
Our backyard / pool renovation project started 8 years ago when we bought the house…at least it started 8 years ago in my mind.  Since then just wishful thinking that is until Jan 2020.  We had interviewed a few pool companies getting recommendation and estimates to do a backyard makeover.  Of the companies that had come out – they took forever to provide an estimate and offered very little to no ideas.  More or less – their approach was “tell me what you want and we will quote that.”  This was not what I was looking for.  If we were going to spend this type of money – we wanted a consultation and recommendations.

It was the 12th hour and we found Sunstone Pools on-line as the Spray Deck dealer in Southlake and they had many positive google reviews. We decided to stop by their showroom and take a look just before they closed on a Saturday.  One of the partners Kevin let us in and happily discussed our vision. During the visit we learned they provided all the backyard makeover services we were seeking.  He knew we were trying to make a final decision within the next week and made it a goal to come out, provide his vision for our yard, and provide the estimate quickly.

Our initial project scope – plaster, tile, coping, and decking

As our project began to take shape with Sunstone, the other partner, Brad, began to work with us on the final details and managing the project through the end. Brad brought new ideas, was willing to think outside the box and will not settle for less than first in class when it comes to his workers. He expects a lot from them, and they rise to meet those expectations.

We selected Sunstone Pools within 2 weeks of having met them.  They delivered the confidence, ideas, competency, and value we were seeking.

We met the project manager Lynn as soon as the job started. Lynn was our guide to what happened that day and the plan for the next few days. This was a large project. Numerous changes occurred along the way.  Most by us as we added to scope of job. Almost every-day there were workers were present – project manager Lynn was on-site and/or called me.  Was everything perfect? Of course not.  Did Sunstone do a great job communicating and getting everything right – YES.

We ended up going with the following:
•	Quartz plaster finish – love the smooth finish and look
•	Change from salt to chlorine + UV cleaning system
•	Glass tile
•	Cabo beach entry
•	Rolled neck on spa
•	LED lights in pool/spa – awesome colorful light shows
•	Extra pump to power massaging water cannons
•	Hayward equipment and control board – ability to control with phone app is great
•	All new travertine decking + increased overall decking
•	Landscaping lighting

In the end we spent a bit more that we had anticipated; all by our choosing and decision. We received a great value on everything we selected. We feel that the backyard is like a resort! And just in time for the spring.

All the Sunstone Pool employees were professional and courteous!

My only regrets – I wish Sunstone had built the pool initially.  And I wish we would have started the remodel sooner!

I would definitely use Sunstone pools again and have already referred my parents to them!  Without hesitation I would refer to my friends.

T.D.
reviews.author: Todd Dean

reviews.text:
In early 2014 Sunstone Pools and Outdoor Living completed a renovation of our backyard and pool.  Another company was responsible for laying the travertine pavers/deck.   Recently we noticed that a number of the travertine pavers had shifted, including a number around the perimeter of the deck.  Some also had cracked.   Because of Sunstone’s previous excellent work, we contacted Brad for advice.   He soon had an awesome team of workers on the job, lifting the old pavers, leveling, and installing new pavers in appropriate areas.  They also shored up the perimeter of the deck, inserting rebar so that the shifting would not occur again.

We are grateful for the excellent team of workers and the professional job done in a very timely manner.  We are very satisfied with the total experience and highly recommend Sunstone Pools and Outdoor Living.
reviews.author: Pat Quinn

reviews.text:
I hired Sunstone Pools to remodel our swimming pool and install new pavers.  The scope of work included new tiles, travertine pavers, travertine coping, plaster, gas fire pit, and some equipment.

Within 3 weeks of starting, the City issued a “Stop Work Order” to Sunstone Pools for not securing a permit and an electrical and gas line code violation.

Sunstone Pools installed a new gas line for my fire pit with an “unlicensed plumber” and at the “wrong location.”  It took Sunstone Pools almost 2 months and 4 failed attempts to secure a permit.

An Atmos energy technician inspected my home and stated that the new gas line would have never worked and would have affected other gas appliances in my home and gas pool heater and a gas leak may have occurred!!!!

After securing a permit, Sunstone Pools again used the same unlicensed plumber to install the second gas line and the “City stopped construction again.”

After voicing my concerns regarding safety issues and other areas with the pool renovation and paver installation to Sunstone Pools owner….but not being satisfied with his response , I pursued other remedies:

I hired CT Brannon Corporation, a civil engineer and aquatic consulting firm to conduct a on-site inspection and report.  The 19 page report verified my complaints and additional concerns were noted.

I then hired a swimming pool construction manager with 40 years of experience to conduct another on-site inspection.  This study validated the engineering report and provided details on how to repair Sunstone Pools mistakes.

There were many areas of concern plus broken items.  An example is:  Sunstone Pools used “concrete blocks” to build new steps, bench, and new wall “instead of gunite.”  This type of construction is seldom used in the United States ever since gunite became widespread over 30 years ago.  (See pic).

I filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau.

I hired a law firm and they forwarded a demand letter to Sunstone Pools and its attorney.  After fulfilling the state requirement of waiting up to 90 days and no acceptable offer, I have asked my attorney to file a lawsuit.

I also filed an official complaint with the State of Texas under Deceptive Trade Practices, Implied Warranty of and Workmanlike Services.  It is now under investigation.
reviews.author: Rich

reviews.text:
Waited a whole Year to do this review on purpose! This company is Extremely Experienced and Professional. Had a few minor issues which is expected for a big project like this. But they are there for you after the Sale 100%.

Small advise wait until the finished product before you complain. Finished product will look just like this. Perfect! Thank you Sunstone and Team!

Jordan, Justin, Brad and Alba 👏🏻
reviews.author: Gerald Alward

reviews.text: Loved working with Sunstone. Jordan was very creative and patient while we iterated to get the design just right. And Lynn was great project manager. We talked almost every day while the process was going. And, as there always are, there were a few things to fix up at the end and he kept me informed all the way. The construction teams worked 6-7 days a week. Construction during a pandemic and during a polar vortex, and it turned wonderfully. We love our new backyard.
reviews.author: Amar A

reviews.text:
BEWARE: SunStone Pools & Outdoor Living, cancelled an unfinished project via email using a bogus excuse while owing us thousands of dollars and leaving us with an unusable backyard full of rocks, sand, holes, rusted metals, and trash.
The owner, Brad, is refusing to return the money and give us an itemized breakdown of all cost and labor.
He has threaten to countersue me if I take any legal action and has name dropped his Attorney, A. H., to attempt to intimidate me. Below is a summary and I have attached a more detail timeline of events.
May 31, 2023. Agreement. Total Cost $62,950. Verbally discussed with Byron (Sales person) that I needed the project completed July 4th. As of July 5th, I have given SunStone Pools $36,950 and they have only completed $20,550 worth of work.

On June 20, due to an argument with Brad, owner, over a timeline where he shouted and called my idea to fill the pool back up because it was cracking due to the extreme heat stupid. I received a timeline via email with milestones and an agreed completion date of July 14 from Byron at the direction of Mark (marketing) who had de-escalated the situation the day before.
After the owner had asked his workers to leave my house.

By July 5, I started receiving text and calls that they were having trouble sourcing the travertine that they knew back on June 19 that they had to pre order 3 weeks in advance.
That night I sent an official notification to everyone that I needed that project completed by the agreed date of July 14, 2023 as agreed verbally and in writing.
On July 6. Brad sent me an email cancelling the project because according to him, me asking for the project to be completed by the date that was agreed verbally and in writing was "anticipatory breach of contract."
SunStone Pools stopped work and abandon the job, so I requested an itemized breakdown of all costs and labor to determine the exact amount owed to us and that any money owed to us be returned by July 10, 2023 end of day. Brad the owner has refused.

I filed a claim with the BBB and his only response was that he cancelled the project because I "promised not to pay" which is lie and I submitted the email as proof.

His response to this review is a lie.  All I want is my money back for a job he cancelled so that I can get someone to clean the mess his company left behind.

Update: on 8/4 I received an email from Sunstone pools and instead of offering to return the money owed to us.   Brad sent a print screen of this review to me and his Attorney.  I can only guess his intentions, but just in case this review disappears...
reviews.author: Patty

reviews.text: You saw our pool, now look at this amazing patio cover Sunstone created for us! Our backyard looks like a ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ resort! Thank you Jordan Holloway and all of the hard working crew at Sunstone Pools
reviews.author: Angel Cox

reviews.text: WOW!!  Fantastic company!! We were referred to Sunstone Pools for retiling and resurfacing our pool in Southlake. Mark Bauer, the marketing director was the first person we met and he guided us through every step - from the first look at the pool to an emergency visit (within an hour of texting) on the Sunday after the pool was completed. I have never seen teams work together like the crews from Sunstone!! Each part of the job brought a crew of between 3-9 men and each crew worked together flawlessly. Not only were they clearly experts at their job, but they worked incredibly quickly, were highly focused on what needed to be done and it was amazing to watch them work together - and have fun doing it. Each person who came was professional and, before leaving, asked us if we had questions or any concerns. Lynn, the services superintendent, stopped by several times to review the work and troubleshoot any issues. reviews.text:

The old retaining wall was crumbling due to tree roots and poor/no maintenance, and the decking pavers were an unsightly tripping hazard.

We got a very clear bid and project timeline, with an explanation on every line item. As we planned everything out, the team at Sunstone was incredibly helpful, since this was our first pool remodel - what are need-to-haves vs nice-to-haves, what holds up better than other things, how to make the pool water look a certain way, etc.

The project kicked off, and we knew exactly what phase we were at, when it would be completed, and where we were with the draw schedule, at each phase. After the project completed on time, we had an amazing backyard paradise, and no regrets about choosing Sunstone to handle the project. How often do you get to say that?

reviews.text:
We had a huge project. Pool resurface and remodel, new equipment, new decking and an outdoor kitchen with a pergola. The beginning process of hiring, planning and executing our project seemed to go so smoothly....until the work started. We weren't living at the house when the work was being done and there seem to be no supervisors watching their workers. From the start the workers were disrespectful to our property. They threw their trash into our flower beds, discarded construction material all over our property and even dumped blue plaster into our neighbor's grass. I sent pictures to Brad. He promised everything would be cleaned up. It wasn't. We arrived one morning to see the deck completely finished with no drains installed. We told brad and they were eventually installed. We shouldn't have to tell a pool and deck company that drains need to be installed. Neighbors contacted us about loud music and yelling during some very early weekend mornings when they were working. They were using our city garbage bin to haul their construction refuse into a pile on our driveway. They completely destroyed our bin and we had to order a new one. The city sent us citation warnings because they were throwing their construction trash (PVC pipes etc ) into our recycling bin. Many days they blocked our alley  so city services couldn't pass through. Part of the renovation involves setting up the pool. Communication was poor. If we misunderstood procedures and asked questions we were told we were "crazy" and sending "dumb" texts and "accusing" them of not performing work that they performed.  With each call and text to Brad he became more confrontational, rude and unprofessional. He even resorted to name calling. Brad gave us a list of references at the start. Three contacted us back and gave him positive reviews. The fact that our experience was so completely different seems very suspicious. If we would have known at the beginning how unprofessional and aggravating this company would be, we would never had hired them. Please, learn from our mistake.

***Please see the photo of the text that Brad is accusing the sender of  "(unloaded on us in an awful venomous way)" and his actual venomous response.

For piece of mind, we wanted to go with a pool builder who was local, and been in business for a while.   We talked with 4 different local pool builders, and discussed different design ideas.  It so happened that the Sunstone was not only the most involved and brought the most creative ideas… but also offered the best value, allowing us to fit all our wish-list items into our budget.

We worked with Jordan throughout the design and sales process, and he was great with all his design ideas, and challenging our initial thoughts but in a nice, collaborative way.  Most of all, he was VERY patient with us and even took me on a tour of different pools with similar concepts so I could be confident in the final selections.  Before signing the contract, we were introduced to Brad the owner, and toured their design center in Southlake.  Lynn was our project manager, and went above and beyond keeping all the different efforts and work teams moving forward.  If there was any hiccups, Lynn took of it.  You won’t find a better company with their communications, and follow through than Sunstone… and that is extremely important with big construction projects. authentic_signals: Google reviews contain specific project details and employee names (Brad, Jordan, Justin, Tony). Writing styles vary among the positive reviews.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between high Google/Angi ratings (4.6, 4.1) and low Yelp rating (3.6) with an F rating from BBB. Yelp search results show widespread negative warnings about cancelled projects, which is not reflected in the positive Google reviews.
